extraction_notes: Rounding/precision differences: the Manager's letter (page 2) states "an LVR of 47%" and a weighted average lease term of "3.4 years", whereas the key information summary (page 3) and Note 5 valuation summary (page 25) give 46.52% and 3.35 years respectively - the more precise figures were recorded. Key information tiles round valuation to $115.0M, loan to $53.5M and net assets per unit to $45K; precise figures taken from the financial statements/financial analysis. No interest coverage ratio actual is disclosed - only the covenant (net rentals no less than 2.0 times interest expense, Note 6; the post-balance-date ASB facility covenant is expressed as EBITDA no less than 2.0 times interest expense, Note 17). 'adjusted_operating_profit' has been taken from the report's line labelled "Adjusted net profit" ($5,303,580) in the non-GAAP reconciliation - the report does not use the term "adjusted operating profit"; note also "Operating profit" per the statement of comprehensive income is $4,899,875 and "Cash surplus available" is $5,267,177. No forecast figures are presented. Occupancy is not stated as a percentage; Note 5 states the property is "fully leased at balance date" while the valuation summary shows a vacancy rate of 0.24%. Borrowings were reclassified from non-current to current at 31 March 2026 reflecting the Westpac facility maturity on 30 September 2026; the facility was refinanced with ASB on 24 June 2026 (post balance date) with swaps novated on unchanged terms.
